title: Reverse Vowels of a String
description:
# Reverse Vowels of a String

Given a string `s`, reverse only all the vowels in the string and return it.

The vowels are `'a'`, `'e'`, `'i'`, `'o'`, and `'u'`, and they can appear in both lower and upper cases, more than once.

## Example 1:

**Input:** s = "hello"
**Output:** "holle"

## Example 2:

**Input:** s = "leetcode"
**Output:** "leotcede"

## Constraints:

*   `1 <= s.length <= 3 * 10^5`
*   `s` consist of printable ASCII characters.

solutions.name: Two Pointers
solutions.description: Convert to char array. Use two pointers from both ends, swapping only when both point to vowels.

solutions.name: Collect and Reverse Vowels
solutions.description: Collect all vowels into a list, then iterate through the string again replacing vowels in reverse order from the list.
